description: Scan code, config, logs, diffs or prompts for leaked credentials before you commit, share or send them to an LLM: 50+ rules (AWS, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Stripe, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Hugging Face, npm, PyPI, Twilio, Telegram, Discord, DigitalOcean, Vault, database URLs, JWTs, PEM private keys) plus crypto-wallet secrets (EVM/Solana hex and base58 keys, Solana keypair arrays, checksum-validated Bitcoin WIF, seed phrases) and entropy-checked generic password assignments. Findings carry line/column, severity, entropy and a redacted preview (secrets are never echoed); placeholders and documented example keys are marked; optional fully redacted copy of the input. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/secret-scan

redact.description: Also return the text with every finding replaced by [REDACTED:<rule>]
